name: Filter — number
description: Branches pass / fail. Test one numeric field (e.g. a flight number) against one or several conditions — equals, ≥, ≤, between, in a list — combined with ALL (and) or ANY (or). A single node replaces a chain of single-compare filters.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: The number to test — pick a numeric field from the request, or use 'Count of' to count items in an array.

params.name: operator
params.description: How to compare the source against the value(s). (Legacy single-compare port — the conditions list supersedes it.)

enum.label: = equals
enum.description: Source is exactly equal to the value.

enum.label: ≠ not equal
enum.description: Source differs from the value.

enum.label: < less than
enum.description: Source is strictly less than the value.

enum.label: ≤ less or equal
enum.description: Source is less than or equal to the value.

enum.label: > greater than
enum.description: Source is strictly greater than the value.

enum.label: ≥ greater or equal
enum.description: Source is greater than or equal to the value.

enum.label: in list
enum.description: Source matches any item in the values list.

enum.label: not in list
enum.description: Source matches none of the values list.

enum.label: is null
enum.description: Pass when the source is null / missing. Value is ignored.

params.name: value
params.description: The number to compare against (single-value operators). Ignored for in / not_in (use the values list) and is_null.

params.name: values
params.description: List of numbers, used by in / not_in.

params.name: round
params.description: Optional rounding applied to the source before comparing — handy for fare amounts where stored decimals don't quite line up with the price-table integer.

enum.label: Floor
enum.description: Round down to the nearest integer.

enum.label: Ceiling
enum.description: Round up to the nearest integer.

enum.label: Half-to-even
enum.description: Banker's rounding (closest integer; ties go to even).

params.name: arraySelector
params.description: When the source resolves to multiple numbers, which match decides pass/fail.

enum.label: Any match
enum.description: Pass if at least one element satisfies the test.

enum.label: All match
enum.description: Pass only if every element satisfies the test.

enum.label: None match
enum.description: Pass only when zero elements satisfy the test.

enum.label: First only
enum.description: Test the first element only.

enum.label: Only one
enum.description: Pass only when the array has exactly one element AND it satisfies the test.

params.name: onMissing
params.description: What to do when the source path isn't in the request.

enum.label: Fail
enum.description: Treat as not matching.

enum.label: Skip
enum.description: Stop this rule and move on.

enum.label: Pass
enum.description: Treat as matching.
